headline: Move from slow campaign planning to governed, review-ready audience and content decisions.
capabilities: Automatically segment customers based on real behavior and value signals
Design multi-wave campaigns with tailored messaging, offers, and timing
Continuously optimize engagement through automated testing and workflows
outcomes: Drove higher conversion rates via precision-targeted campaigns
Reduced campaign planning cycles from weeks to hours
Increased repeat purchases and average order value
Provided leaders with real-time performance insights to guide decisions during peak periods
why_try: It gives leaders and campaign operators a common planning surface while keeping audience selection, copy, incentives, and launch decisions behind human approval.

sample_prompts.prompt: Outline the review-only win-back sequence, assumptions, and approval gates.
